adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a client action `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});` (admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), while the server `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` does not read/permit/update any params and simply re-renders the current embedding (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). This creates a misleading update pathway (client sends an empty payload; server is a no-op) that could invite incorrect future wiring when embedding-level settings are added. It’s not a current runtime defect (and there’s no template usage of `saveChanges` in the added `embedding.hbs`), but it is a concrete, diff-grounded design/maintenance concern.
